title: DR1 puts an "Enter contact details" heading above the private transporter's email and phone and asks for the email first; the frontend runs the two fields straight on from the address with no heading and asks for the telephone number first.

finding.frontend: The form runs nine fields in one unbroken column — name, four address lines, postal code, country, then Telephone number and Email address — with nothing marking where the address stops and the contact details start (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/private-transporter-details/private-transporter-details.njk:73-90). The two contact fields are also in the opposite order to DR1's.
finding.prototype: After the country field DR1 opens a new block with the heading "Enter contact details", and under it asks for the email address and then the phone number (app/views/partials/transporter-add-private-fields.html:84-109).
finding.difference: Add an "Enter contact details" heading between the country field and the contact fields, and swap the two so email is asked before phone. Layout and copy only; no field is added or removed and no validation changes. Do it with the missing phone hint, which is in the same block.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a heading between the country select and the telephone input on fe-transporter-private — the captured DOM goes from one govuk-form-group to the next with no heading element in between.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs and both full-page screenshots, and read app/views/partials/transporter-add-private-fields.html whole. Ran the falsifier: the frontend's captured DOM runs label for="country" at line 173 to label for="telephoneNumber" at line 216 with no heading element between them — the only h2 on the page is the visually hidden "Support links" in the footer — so it does not fire. The nine fields are in the order the slot gives, and the screenshots confirm Telephone number above Email address on the frontend and "Enter contact details" above Email address above Phone number in DR1. CORRECT. One citation is one line short: the partial's h2 is at :85, not :84, though the cited range :84-109 contains it and the whole contact block; not nudged, because the finding it supports re-verified true.
